{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()

# Check if 'arm' is balanced across other variables
# Cross-tabulate arm with severity and sex
arm_severity_ct = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['severity'])
arm_sex_ct = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], trial_df['sex'])

# Print results
duplicates, arm_severity_ct, arm_sex_ct"}
